subject: Intro + short demo — CloudNova (AWS Marketplace inquiry)
messages:
From: Sam Ellis <sam.ellis@cloudnova.io>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick demo request after AWS Marketplace listing

Hi Jasmine,

Spotted Redwood on the AWS Marketplace today — looks like a great fit for how we want to serve our LLM-driven features. I'm Sam, head of platform at CloudNova. We launched a pilot of a search-relevance feature and are evaluating inference vendors for a production launch.

Would love a 20–30 minute intro + short demo to see latency/cost tradeoffs and how model variants + routing would work. We prefer late-morning PST next week but can be flexible.

A few quick notes about us:
- Team: 4 infra engs, 2 ML engineers
- Primary constraint: sub-200ms 95th percentile for short completions
- Compliance: SOC2 in progress

Could you propose a couple slots?

Thanks,
Sam Ellis
Head of Platform, CloudNova
sam.ellis@cloudnova.io
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Sam Ellis <sam.ellis@cloudnova.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request after AWS Marketplace listing

Hey Sam — great to meet you and welcome (glad you found us on Marketplace). I can do a short 20–30 minute session to walk through: product overview, latency/cost profile, and a quick look at routing/variants that would matter for your use case.

Suggested slots (PST):
- Tue 2026-09-01 10:00–10:30
- Tue 2026-09-01 11:30–12:00
- Wed 2026-09-02 09:00–09:30

If those don't work, send a few windows that do and I’ll match. I looped in Ben (AE) to help with specific pricing and integration questions.

Attached: redwood-quickdeck.pdf — 1-pager + short architecture notes.

Quick ask from our side: could you share a rough QPS expectation and whether you need private deployment (VPC/on-prem) or hosted first? Helps us tailor the demo.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
SDR, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-quickdeck.pdf (application/pdf, 480 KB)
From: Sam Ellis <sam.ellis@cloudnova.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request after AWS Marketplace listing

Thanks Jasmine — Tue 2026-09-01 11:30–12:00 PST works for us.

QPS: peak ~7 QPS, steady ~1–2 QPS. We're starting hosted but evaluating a private deployment for compliance by Q1. SOC2 expected by EOY.

Attendees on our side: myself, Priya (ML Eng, priya@cloudnova.io), and Raj (Infra, raj@cloudnova.io). Can Ben share a rough ballpark for monthly unit costs for hosted use during the meeting?

Sam

1) 5m quick intros + CloudNova goals
2) 10m demo: hosted inference flow, routing policies, and perf/cost dashboard
3) 5–10m pricing/next steps (ballpark committed vs. pay-as-you-go)
